subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom from the given options to fill in the blank.

Being a journalist, your first duty is to ____________ or else your colleagues might surpass you.

options.text: keep your ear to the ground

solution:
The correct answer is: **keep your ear to the ground**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"keep your ear to the ground"** means to be well-informed about current trends or events, or to be aware of what is happening around you. (सावधान रहना)

 
 
• **Example:** To succeed in the stock market, you need to keep your ear to the ground and be aware of financial news.
 
 
 
• **"Being a journalist, your first duty is to keep your ear to the ground"** means that a journalist should always be alert and aware of the latest news and trends. (पत्रकार के रूप में, आपकी पहली जिम्मेदारी सतर्क और जागरूक रहना है)
 
 
• **Example:** As an investigative journalist, she always keeps her ear to the ground to uncover new stories.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **keep your ear to the ground**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eat a humble pie** (नम्रता से माफी माँगना): To admit one's faults or errors and apologize.

 
 
• **Example:** After the mistake was pointed out, he had to eat a humble pie and apologize to the team.
 
 
 
• **Have an axe to grind** (अपनी व्यक्तिगत शिकायत होना): To have a personal reason for complaining or arguing.
 
 
• **Example:** He has an axe to grind with his manager because of the recent promotion he didn't get.
 
 
 
• **Build castles in the air** (हवाई किले बनाना): To create dreams, hopes, or plans that are unrealistic or unlikely to happen.
 
 
• **Example:** Instead of building castles in the air, you should focus on achievable goals.
